title: 電気電子工学専門実験Ａ
subtitle: Major Laboratories for Electrical and Electronic Engineering A
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) learn basic knowledge regarding electrical and electronic measurement and experiments, developing the ability to actually perform measurement and analysis.
(2) learn to independently propose and find solutions for new challenges in the field of electric and electronic engineering.
(3) learn to create clear and meaningful lab reports
advice:
This course deals with the basic principles of fundamental laboratory techniques for electrical and electronic engineering. It also enhances the development of students’ skill in carrying out the experiment for electrical and electronic engineering. We will conduct the following six experimental subjects:

(1) Power device characteristics
(2) Amplifier
(3) Optical semiconductor device characteristics
(4) Transformer characteristics
(5) Power converter circuits
(6) Electronic circuit design

Students conduct experiments (1st week) and oral exam (2nd week) on an experimental subject.
books: Major Experiments for Electrical and Electronic Engineering A・B (Kanazawa Institute of Technology, 2022)
requiredKnowledge:
Knowledge of basic electrical and electronic engineering.
Basic laboratory skills (knowledge of “Introduction to Project Design” and “Project Design / Implementation and Operation”).

activityGoals.body: Be able to acquire basic knowledge about measurement, experiment, computer and automatic control
Be able to carry out the experiment for electrical and electronic engineering in safe and appropriate methods
Be able to theoretically calculate using the measured value and be able to create the clear and accurate tables
Be able to create the lab reports with theoretical discussions for experimental results
